governance_layers: Watch-only fallback when autonomous gates fail
Human paper-trade approval for manual overrides
Autonomous paper mandate within hard risk limits
Human escalation monitor for restricted changes
tools_and_workflows: Autonomous paper planner and execution loop
autonomy_boundary: The Committee may autonomously plan, enter, manage, exit, review, and learn from simulated positions. It may not place live orders, connect live-money authority, expose credentials, or weaken immutable risk limits.
rule: If it makes or challenges a decision, it can be a Committee agent. If it supplies facts, context, signals, or calculations, it is a shared data layer. If it enforces discipline, limits, approvals, or safety, it is governance. If it records outcomes or improves future judgment, it is memory. If it tracks, executes, displays, or notifies, it is a tool or workflow.
